name: AyanamiMem
description: Session-isolated hierarchical memory with BM25+vector hybrid search. Human-readable .md files, local embeddings, no database required.

memoryRoot.description: Root directory for all session memory trees (default: ~/.ayanamimem/sessions)

sessionId.description: Override session ID. Default: derived from event.agentId.

topK.description: Number of memories to recall per query.

freshTailCount.description: Most-recent leaves always included verbatim, never compacted.

compactThreshold.description: Non-tail leaves in _fresh/ before auto-compaction triggers.

compactSimilarity.description: Cosine threshold for clustering leaves into topic groups.

mergeThreshold.description: Cosine threshold for merging a new cluster into an existing dir.

chatModel.description: LLM model for memory extraction and summarisation.

enableBm25.description: Enable BM25Plus keyword search alongside vector search.

enableMmr.description: Enable Maximal Marginal Relevance diversity re-ranking.

rrfK.description: RRF constant k (higher = less aggressive top-rank boosting).

notes: Set OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_BASE_URL for LLM memory extraction/summarisation.
Optional: set EMBEDDER_MODEL to a local model path for offline embeddings.
Optional: set MEMORY_ROOT to customize where .md session files are stored.
Memory files are stored as human-readable Markdown — open them in any editor.
